commit_message: Complete ADR 0122 spatial audio authoring core
pr_title: Continue ADR 0122 spatial audio ECS synchronization
pr_body:
<!-- gameengine-chatgpt-dispatcher -->

Continues ADR 0122 on the latest-main baseline. This request adds current-format spatial authoring fields (rolloff, loop, listener priority), priority-based deterministic listener selection, managed looping/rolloff composition, shared listener diagnostics, Transform dependency validation, and canonical scene fixture coverage.

Further ADR 0122 Project Rust and Editor authoring/preview UX work will follow on fresh request IDs before the ADR is marked Accepted.
